note: Vendor-neutral names for what code is trying to do. Each idiom says what a check must confirm. Entries in apis/ map a vendor call into an idiom; entries in impl/ say how a target does that idiom, with proof.

system.init.means: one call at start that brings the chip and its clocks and pins to a known state
system.init.check: program reaches main loop; a pin toggles

clock.system_config.means: choose the CPU and bus clock tree at start
clock.system_config.check: measure a timer or a baud rate against the clock the code assumes

clock.peripheral_enable.means: turn on the bus clock or power of a peripheral before touching its registers
clock.peripheral_enable.check: read back a register of the peripheral; zero after power-up means it was not enabled

time.delay_ms.check: scope or logic analyzer on a toggling pin against the period the source states

time.delay_cycles.means: blocking wait of N CPU cycles
time.delay_cycles.check: pin pulse width at the clock in use

time.tick_ms.check: two reads 1 s apart differ by 1000

time.tick_us.check: two reads 1 s apart differ by 1,000,000

time.periodic_irq.means: interrupt at a fixed period (system tick or timer)

irq.enable.means: enable one interrupt line in the core's interrupt controller

irq.priority.means: set the preemption priority of one interrupt
irq.priority.check: two handlers that must not preempt each other do not

irq.global_disable.means: mask all interrupts around a critical section and restore the previous mask
irq.global_disable.check: shared state stays consistent under load

irq.vector_name.means: the name of the interrupt handler function the startup file binds to a vector
irq.vector_name.check: the handler runs; a missing name falls into the default endless loop

gpio.config_pin.means: set a pin as output, input, pull-up or pull-down, or alternate function
gpio.config_pin.check: read the pin level with and without a load

gpio.write.means: drive an output pin high or low
gpio.write.check: pin level on a meter or logic analyzer

gpio.read.check: read with the input driven both ways

gpio.input_irq_edge.means: interrupt on a pin edge, with the pull and edge the button needs
gpio.input_irq_edge.check: press the button (or drive the pin) and see one handler run per press

gpio.irq_callback.means: application function called from the pin interrupt
gpio.irq_callback.check: one call per edge, not two

board.led_button.means: the LED and button pins and their active level on the target board
board.led_button.check: LED on when the code says on; button press reads as pressed

uart.init_8n1.means: open a UART at a baud rate, 8 data bits, no parity, one stop bit
uart.init_8n1.check: host terminal at that baud shows the text

uart.fifo_config.means: UART FIFO enable and threshold levels
uart.fifo_config.check: no lost bytes at the line rate; check the FIFO depth in the data sheet

uart.tx_blocking.means: send a buffer and wait until it has left

uart.tx_byte_blocking.means: send one byte after the transmit register is free

uart.rx_byte_blocking.means: wait for and read one received byte
uart.rx_byte_blocking.check: send one byte from the host and see it in code

uart.tx_dma.means: transmit a buffer by DMA and learn when it is done
uart.tx_dma.check: host reads the exact bytes while the CPU does other work; done interrupt fires once per buffer

uart.dma_trigger.means: tie the UART receive or transmit request to a DMA channel
uart.dma_trigger.check: bytes reach memory with no CPU read

uart.rx_circular_dma.means: receive into a ring buffer by DMA with half and full transfer events
uart.rx_circular_dma.check: burst of packets at the line rate with none lost

uart.rx_until_idle.means: know when the sender went quiet (idle-line event) so a partial buffer can be handed on
uart.rx_until_idle.check: a one-packet message is answered without a following packet; round trip against the original

analog.comparator.means: analog comparator with a reference and an output pin or interrupt
analog.comparator.check: output follows the input crossing the reference; with nothing driven the program only loops

analog.opamp.check: output equals gain times input on a known input

system.reset.means: software reset and the reset-cause flags read after boot
system.reset.check: cause flag differs after a software reset from after power-up

uart.driver_api.means: the vendor's open/read/write/close UART driver (blocking or callback), not registers
uart.driver_api.check: same text and same echo as the original driver example

config.generated_names.means: the port, pin and instance names a vendor's config tool writes into its header and the application uses
config.generated_names.check: application compiles with no edit; the names point at the same pins

console.print.means: text output to the serial console
console.print.check: same text on the host terminal

dma.config_channel.means: set a DMA channel's direction, increment modes, data widths and mode
dma.config_channel.check: memory holds the expected bytes after one transfer

dma.set_addr_len.means: set source, destination and transfer length for the next DMA transfer
dma.set_addr_len.check: length moved equals the length asked

dma.channel_enable.means: start or stop a DMA channel

dma.remaining_count.means: bytes the DMA has still to move, used as a write position
dma.remaining_count.check: position equals the bytes sent so far

dma.complete_irq.means: interrupt when a DMA transfer is done, and clearing its flag

dma.circular_halfcomplete.means: a DMA that wraps by itself and interrupts at half and full
dma.circular_halfcomplete.check: no byte lost across the wrap at the line rate

adc.config_channel.means: choose ADC channels, resolution, sampling time and trigger
adc.config_channel.check: known input voltage reads the expected counts

adc.start_conversion.means: start a conversion and read the result
adc.start_conversion.check: known input voltage reads the expected counts

adc.multichannel_dma.means: convert a sequence of channels and move all results to memory by DMA
adc.multichannel_dma.check: buffer holds one fresh result per channel after each start; the next start works too

adc.done_callback.means: application function when the conversion buffer is full

pwm.config_channel.means: set period, duty and polarity of a PWM channel
pwm.config_channel.check: duty and frequency on a logic analyzer

pwm.start_channel.check: pin shows the duty cycle the source set

power.sleep.means: stop the CPU until an interrupt, in a sleep or deep sleep state
power.sleep.check: current drops; the wake interrupt runs

wdt.watchdog.means: reset the chip if the program stops feeding the watchdog
wdt.watchdog.check: unfed watchdog resets; fed one does not; check the window rules

crc.compute.check: same value as a host script for the same bytes

flash.write.means: erase and program the chip's own flash
flash.write.check: read back equals what was written; neighbours intact

rtos.task_create.check: task runs and shares the CPU with the others

rtos.delay.means: sleep the calling task for N ticks

atomic.c11.means: C11 atomics used by a portable library (ring buffers)
atomic.c11.check: library test passes; no atomic library call in the link map

vendor.no_equivalent.means: a call that configures something only the source chip has
vendor.no_equivalent.check: behavior that the call served is checked by name

hid.report_descriptor_pack.means: build a HID report descriptor and pack an input report from button and axis state
hid.report_descriptor_pack.check: descriptor and reports equal the original's bytes on the same call sequence

bytes.pack_8bit.means: store bytes in a buffer that goes to a byte-oriented radio or host

ble.stack_init.means: start the Bluetooth LE host and controller

ble.gatt_server.means: create a GATT server and register services

ble.gatt_characteristic.means: define a service, characteristic or descriptor with UUID, properties and permissions
ble.gatt_characteristic.check: client reads and writes it; properties match

ble.hid_service.means: HID over GATT service: information, report map, control point, protocol mode, report with report reference
ble.hid_service.check: host OS lists the device as HID and reads the report map

ble.hid_report_notify.means: set an input report value and notify the subscribed host
ble.hid_report_notify.check: host receives the report bytes when subscribed

ble.advertise.means: advertising data, appearance, name, service UUIDs, restart after disconnect
ble.advertise.check: scanner sees name, appearance and UUIDs; advertises again after a disconnect

ble.device_info.means: Device Information service fields (manufacturer, model, serial, revisions, PnP ID)
ble.device_info.check: client reads the same strings as the original

ble.conn_callbacks.means: application callbacks for connect, disconnect, subscribe, pairing
ble.conn_callbacks.check: each event reaches the application once

ble.security_bonding.means: pairing method, encryption of attribute reads, bonding
ble.security_bonding.check: host pairs and the link is encrypted; reconnect works

boot.jump_to_app.means: a bootloader starts another program image whose vector table sits elsewhere in flash
boot.jump_to_app.check: the application's own interrupts run after the jump, and a reset with a stored image jumps again

uart.recover_after_error.means: make the UART usable again after a timeout, an overrun or an aborted transfer
uart.recover_after_error.check: after an aborted transfer a good one still works

gpio.open_drain_soft_i2c.means: open-drain pin emulated with output enable and a read-back, for bit-banged I2C
gpio.open_drain_soft_i2c.check: read an I2C device ID through the bit-banged bus

adc.single_channel_runtime_select.means: read one ADC channel chosen at run time, one conversion at a time
adc.single_channel_runtime_select.check: counts at rest match the expected mid-scale or zero

adc.button_on_analog_only_pin.means: a button read through an ADC channel because the pin has no GPIO function
adc.button_on_analog_only_pin.check: released reads near full scale; pressed reads near zero

uart.tx_only_console.means: print console that claims only the transmit pin
uart.tx_only_console.check: the receive pin still works as a button or other input

spi.display_stream_dma.means: stream a block of display bytes over SPI by DMA with a done flag
spi.display_stream_dma.check: frame time equals bytes times 8 over the clock, plus start-up

time.cycle_stamp.means: free-running counter for timing a frame, from the cycle counter or the system tick
time.cycle_stamp.check: two stamps around a delay differ by the delay

sysconfig.generate_from_pin_table.means: write the pin-configuration file and the C header from one table
sysconfig.generate_from_pin_table.check: generated files build for every board in the table

display.frl_platform_adapter.means: connect a portable game layer to a board display, stick and buzzer through one small adapter
display.frl_platform_adapter.check: the game draws and the stick moves it

spi.frame_whole_word.means: a converter write that must arrive as one 16-bit frame with chip select held low
spi.frame_whole_word.check: the converter output changes; split transfers leave it unchanged

gpio.shutdown_active_high.means: an amplifier shutdown input that is active high whatever the header calls it
gpio.shutdown_active_high.check: sound plays with the line low and not with it high

adc.software_triggered_single.means: one software-started conversion of one channel
adc.software_triggered_single.check: a known voltage reads the expected counts

timer.periodic_tick_8khz.means: periodic tick at a fixed rate derived from the real core clock
timer.periodic_tick_8khz.check: the capture rate matches the tone bins in a DFT

build.sdk_example_frame_extra_sources.means: reuse a vendor example makefile and add the repository sources to it
build.sdk_example_frame_extra_sources.check: the image builds and the stale generated header is gone

i2c.bus_recover.means: free a bus held low by a sensor after a reset: nine clocks and a stop on the pins as GPIO
i2c.bus_recover.check: the bus reads idle high and the next transfer succeeds

gpio.power_switch_pin.means: a header pin that switches the supply of a sensor, with its own polarity
gpio.power_switch_pin.check: the sensor answers only when the pin is in its on state

sysconfig.pin_missing.means: a pin the board file names but the SysConfig device data does not offer
sysconfig.pin_missing.check: SysConfig runs without error for the chosen pin set

imu.bmi160_stream.means: burst read of motion data at a fixed rate with sensor timestamps
imu.bmi160_stream.check: 100 Hz with no missing sample over a minute

serial.csv_stream_100hz.means: text lines streamed at 100 per second over a UART
serial.csv_stream_100hz.check: line count and rate over a minute

mem.progmem_read.means: read constant data placed in program memory on a chip with split address spaces

audio.square_tone.means: start a square-wave tone of a frequency and duration
audio.square_tone.check: dominant frequency from a microphone or capture

display.page_buffer_1bit.means: a one-bit page-format frame buffer streamed to a different panel
display.page_buffer_1bit.check: the same picture on the panel as on the host

input.stick_to_dpad.means: two-axis analog stick turned into four directions with a dead band
input.stick_to_dpad.check: each direction fires once and rest fires none

time.frame_pacing.means: fixed frame rate loop over a millisecond clock
time.frame_pacing.check: one frame per period over a run

build.arduino_sketch.means: build an .ino sketch with a plain C++ compiler

lib.rand_arduino.means: random numbers with a seed from an entropy source or the clock

udp.server_bind.means: bind a UDP port and answer each datagram

net.wifi_join_static.means: join a Wi-Fi network with credentials fixed at build time

rodata.table_in_flash.means: a large constant table linked into execute-in-place flash
rodata.table_in_flash.check: table bytes read back from the mapped address

http.status_page.means: serve one small status page over TCP
http.status_page.check: a browser or curl gets the page

lcd.fill_rect_push_pixels.means: fill a rectangle and push pixel data to a 16-bit SPI screen
lcd.fill_rect_push_pixels.check: measured full-screen fill time and picture on the panel

lcd.full_frame_buffer.means: a full-screen frame buffer in RAM
lcd.full_frame_buffer.check: the panel shows the picture without the buffer

touch.read_point.means: read one touch point from the touch controller
touch.read_point.check: finger coordinates, or no failed reads over many polls

touch.gesture.means: turn touch points into tap, long press and swipe
touch.gesture.check: scripted gestures give the expected events

time.millis_micros.means: millisecond and microsecond clocks from the system tick
time.millis_micros.check: two reads one second apart differ by 1000 ms

data.pgm_table.means: constant tables for fonts and sprites

dsp.filter_bank.means: bank of filters, one per band

npu.skip_normalize.means: feed int8 data to a compiled model without the float input scaling
npu.skip_normalize.check: no CPU layer in the compile log

clock.pll_80mhz_checked.means: start the PLL and verify its frequency with the counter before switching to it
clock.pll_80mhz_checked.check: frequency counter reads the target within tolerance

gpio.pin_by_name.means: address a pin by port and bit name through a generated table

gpio.open_drain_emulated.means: open-drain from an input with pull-up and an output enabled only to pull low
gpio.open_drain_emulated.check: a bit-banged bus reads idle and scans

bus.soft_i2c_spi.check: a scan or transfer on idle pins behaves as expected

memory.ecc_sram_prime.means: write every word of an error-corrected RAM before byte stores

gc.heap_from_linker.means: size the managed heap from linker symbols
gc.heap_from_linker.check: free heap reads as expected after boot

build.vendor_startup_reuse.means: compile the vendor start-up file unchanged and match its symbols in the linker file

runtime.python_console_uart.means: Python REPL on a UART with an interrupt-fed ring
runtime.python_console_uart.check: banner and prompt on the UART

display.frame_out_direct.means: hand each rendered frame to the platform without an output buffer

render.screen_melt_off.means: compile out a transition effect that needs extra screens

storage.wad_lump_read.means: read a large data file in pieces or in place
storage.wad_lump_read.check: the file hashes to the expected SHA-1

libc.no_files_no_stdio.means: run code that uses files and stdio on a target with neither
libc.no_files_no_stdio.check: the program starts and logs without stopping

memory.zone_static.means: a fixed-size static pool in place of a large malloc

rodata.state_tables_const.means: keep large read-only tables in flash
rodata.state_tables_const.check: map shows the data section shrink

render.static_limits_trimmed.means: compile-time limits sized to the data actually used
render.static_limits_trimmed.check: no limit hit on the test demos

test.arm_binary_in_emulator.means: run the target image in a CPU emulator when the board is not on the bench
test.arm_binary_in_emulator.check: frame checksums equal the host build

memory.place_big_array.means: place a named large array first in a chosen RAM region by linker section
memory.place_big_array.check: the map shows the section at the address

memory.use_code_ram_for_data.means: use a code RAM block as ordinary data
memory.use_code_ram_for_data.check: data in the block reads back

flash.application_slot_size.means: size the application slot to hold a large image
flash.application_slot_size.check: the signed image builds and boots

rtos.big_thread_stack.means: give an RTOS thread a larger stack
rtos.big_thread_stack.check: the deepest use is below the size

spi.byte_order_lsb_first.means: a peripheral that wants the least significant bit first on an MSB-first SPI
spi.byte_order_lsb_first.check: the panel shows the right pixels

time.ms_tick_no_systick.means: millisecond tick from a timer when the system tick is not available
time.ms_tick_no_systick.check: a counter rises once per millisecond

display.no_framebuffer_bands.means: draw a scene in bands and send each band as its own update
display.no_framebuffer_bands.check: the picture is right with a buffer of a few lines

fs.fat_read_small_ram.means: read a FAT file system with no sector buffer

sd.spi_mode_shared_bus.means: a microSD card in SPI mode on a bus shared with a panel
sd.spi_mode_shared_bus.check: card reads work and the panel stays right

rtos.none_stack_painting.means: measure stack use by painting the unused stack
rtos.none_stack_painting.check: free bytes read after the run

debug.attach_resets_target.means: read results in the same debugger session that flashed, since a second attach resets the chip
debug.attach_resets_target.check: the struct read shows the running state

display.spi_panel_init.means: start a small SPI panel from devicetree
display.spi_panel_init.check: the picture is the right way up and in place

gpio.header_nexus.means: BoosterPack header as a GPIO map with a mask
gpio.header_nexus.check: a pin reference with flags resolves

devicetree.label_order.means: order of overlay includes when a shield uses the board connector

spi.pin_mux_missing.means: declare a pin function the HAL pinctrl file does not list
spi.pin_mux_missing.check: the clock appears on the pin

spi.bitbang_fallback.means: SPI by GPIO toggling when no SPI driver exists
spi.bitbang_fallback.check: the same display node works on it

gpio.port_tables.means: pins in a port the driver tables do not name

display.memory_lcd.means: memory LCD with a periodic polarity flip sent in the serial data

dac.spi_dac_audio.means: SPI DAC and amplifier audio output
dac.spi_dac_audio.check: the right frequency from a microphone

build.lvgl_options.means: graphics library option names that change between releases

display.scale_to_square.means: scale a picture to a square panel with packed shades and ordered dither
display.scale_to_square.check: picture compared by eye with the source

input.dpad_two_buttons.means: stick and two buttons as a D-pad with chords for the missing buttons

storage.rom_in_place.means: read a ROM image where it sits in flash

time.benchmark_cpu.means: benchmark by process CPU time on a loaded host
time.benchmark_cpu.check: median of runs within a few percent

safety.rom_indexed_arrays.means: array indexes taken from untrusted file bytes
safety.rom_indexed_arrays.check: crafted input fails the unpatched build and passes the patched one

adc.single_channel_mv.means: read one analog sensor output on a fixed ADC channel and convert to millivolts
adc.single_channel_mv.check: a known sensor output reads the expected voltage

emulator.frontend_present_hook.means: connect an emulator or game layer to a board display through one present call, so only setup and loop are new
emulator.frontend_present_hook.check: the title screen of the game is drawn

dsp.pitch_yin_fixed.means: monophonic pitch in cents from integer arithmetic
dsp.pitch_yin_fixed.check: error against a double-precision reference on sine, guitar-like and noisy tones

dsp.fft_q15_block_float.means: spectrum bars from a 16-bit fixed-point FFT with a shared exponent
dsp.fft_q15_block_float.check: bar heights within a pixel or two of a double-precision DFT

dsp.goertzel_dtmf.means: keypad tone decoding with eight Goertzel filters and a decision rule
dsp.goertzel_dtmf.check: decoded digits against the sent digits across a noise sweep

audio.noise_gate_echo.means: a noise gate and an echo in integer arithmetic
audio.noise_gate_echo.check: attenuation when closed and impulse response of the delay line

build.cycle_counter_dwt.means: cycle counter that a board without the Cortex-M33 trace unit can still link against
build.cycle_counter_dwt.check: the app links on both boards and reads zero where there is no counter

mem.mmap_weights.means: model weights read in place from a file mapping
mem.mmap_weights.check: weights sit at an aligned address in flash and the first token matches

mem.static_runstate.means: run-time buffers sized at build time instead of allocated
mem.static_runstate.check: the program has no malloc and the image fits RAM

mem.lazy_dequant_row.means: convert only the row of a large table that the current step needs
mem.lazy_dequant_row.check: output bytes equal the full-table version

quant.group_size_divides_all.means: quantization group size that divides every vector length
quant.group_size_divides_all.check: the size divides every dimension; greedy output matches the float build

ml.torch_free_export.means: model export without the training framework
ml.torch_free_export.check: the unmodified runner loads the file and matches the float model at temperature 0

libc.sscanf_byte_token.means: hand-parsed byte token in place of sscanf
libc.sscanf_byte_token.check: output equal to the sscanf build

libc.sprintf_concat.means: string concatenation without the printf family
libc.sprintf_concat.check: output equal to the sprintf build

math.libm_float.means: single-precision math functions from the target C library
math.libm_float.check: greedy output equal; logit drift measured

host.emulator_run_to_symbol.means: run firmware in an emulator until a named symbol, then read a result block in RAM
host.emulator_run_to_symbol.check: the emulator stops at the symbol and the block holds the expected values

runtime.wasm_interpreter_fixed_heap.means: a bytecode interpreter whose heap is one static array
runtime.wasm_interpreter_fixed_heap.check: no malloc is linked and the heap high-water mark is read

runtime.native_stack_budget.means: limit on the native stack an interpreter may use
runtime.native_stack_budget.check: deep recursion traps instead of corrupting memory

runtime.wasm_call_ref_stack_check.means: native stack guard on indirect calls of an interpreter
runtime.wasm_call_ref_stack_check.check: a recursive module traps patched and crashes unpatched

bind.host_function_raw.means: host functions linked into an interpreter by name and signature
bind.host_function_raw.check: each import is called from the module and returns the expected value

build.wasm_without_toolchain.means: a small WebAssembly module made from text without a compiler target
build.wasm_without_toolchain.check: the module runs and gives the C answers

gpio.output_inverted_led.means: a pin driven low to light an LED, with the inversion set once on the pin
gpio.output_inverted_led.check: the pin check sees the pin change and the LED level is the intended one

time.async_timer_delay.means: a delay that yields to an async executor instead of a busy loop
time.async_timer_delay.check: the pin toggles at the requested period

uart.blocking_write_new.means: blocking serial write with the transmit and receive pins named in the order the driver wants

debug.text_without_rtt.means: debug text printed on the UART when the flash path cannot read RTT
debug.text_without_rtt.check: the console shows the text with no probe-rs session

build.hal_git_dependency.means: a hardware layer taken from a pinned git commit when the package registry entry is empty
build.hal_git_dependency.check: the build resolves the same sources twice

build.link_interrupt_group.means: interrupt symbols supplied to the linker when the runtime feature is on
build.link_interrupt_group.check: the image links with every vector defined

storage.data_file_in_flash_xip.means: a large data file included in the image and read in place from external flash
storage.data_file_in_flash_xip.check: SHA of the data matches and the first frames match the reference

memory.short_pointer_window.means: 16-bit pointers into a fixed 256 kB RAM window

memory.bss_all_in_dram.means: all zero-initialised data placed in one RAM region by the linker file
memory.bss_all_in_dram.check: the map shows the sections in that region and the engine runs

time.virtual_game_clock.means: a clock that advances a fixed step per read, so output does not depend on speed

timer.capture_compare_pwm.check: frequency and duty (or captured period) on a logic analyzer against the source's numbers

spi.controller_init.means: open a SPI controller with mode (polarity and phase), bit order and clock rate
spi.controller_init.check: a loopback or a known device returns the bytes sent

i2c.controller_init.means: open an I2C controller at 100 or 400 kHz with the pull-ups and addressing the source used

display.scale_while_drawing.means: a frame scaled to the panel's size while each line is drawn, with no frame copy
display.scale_while_drawing.check: the scaled picture equals the unscaled one in shape on the panel and the instruction count per frame fell

display.stream_rows_dma.means: a frame sent to a panel as one window with rows queued by DMA instead of a blocking write per call
display.stream_rows_dma.check: one window per frame and the screen time per frame equals the wire time

perf.line_buffer_clear.means: a small buffer cleared a word at a time instead of through a library loop that clears a byte per pass
perf.line_buffer_clear.check: instructions per frame before and after, same picture

clock.mspm33_160mhz.means: CPU clock raised from the default tree to the chip's top speed
clock.mspm33_160mhz.check: the clock the firmware reports equals the target and the wait states are set

perf.frame_skip.means: an emulator told to skip drawing every second frame while its logic still runs
perf.frame_skip.check: emulated frames keep the console's rate and the screen shows every second one

memory.fast_ram_for_hot_data.means: hot statics, working zone and stack placed in the fastest RAM, big buffers in slower RAM
memory.fast_ram_for_hot_data.check: load cycles per memory are measured first and the frame rate follows

storage.lump_ram_cache.means: game data read in place from slow flash is copied to a RAM arena on first use
storage.lump_ram_cache.check: frame checksums equal the reference and the frame rate rose

emu.interpreter_core_portable.means: an emulated machine's CPU as one C file with its state in a struct, no allocation and no hardware calls
emu.interpreter_core_portable.check: the same ROM gives the same screen on the host and on the board

emu.display_wait_vblank.means: a draw instruction that waits for the next 60 Hz frame, as the original machine did
emu.display_wait_vblank.check: a text-heavy ROM draws one glyph per frame and shows after the expected frame count

gfx.scaled_dirty_rows.means: a small bitmap scaled up to a panel with only the changed rows sent
gfx.scaled_dirty_rows.check: full redraw time on the board and rows sent per frame

input.touch_keypad.means: a touch panel drawn as the key pad of the original machine
input.touch_keypad.check: a touch changes the key state the program reads

test.automation_byte_0x1ff.means: a test ROM told its platform through a byte in memory so it skips its menu
test.automation_byte_0x1ff.check: the quirks screen equals the host's

emu.cpu_tick_pin_model.means: a CPU emulator that advances one clock per call and returns a pin word the machine decodes
emu.cpu_tick_pin_model.check: the screen memory after a fixed frame count equals the host machine's

emu.core_in_sram.means: an emulator's hot core and tick loop copied to SRAM at boot so its fetches skip the slow flash
emu.core_in_sram.check: emulated speed before and after, measured by the firmware's timers

build.opt_level_for_emulators.means: the optimisation level picked by measuring the emulator, not by the usual default
build.opt_level_for_emulators.check: speed at each level on the same workload

gfx.band_dirty_shadow.means: an interleaved screen layout compared with a shadow copy in bands and only changed bands sent
gfx.band_dirty_shadow.check: screen cost per frame at idle and under change

input.matrix_from_touch.means: a keyboard matrix read by the program built from a touch keyboard
input.matrix_from_touch.check: a touch changes the half-row bytes the program reads

legal.reader_supplies_rom.means: a copyrighted firmware image supplied by the reader at build time and kept out of the repository
legal.reader_supplies_rom.check: a ROM-less image still builds and runs

audio.mp3_decode_float.means: an MP3 decoded frame by frame from a byte array with no file or heap
audio.mp3_decode_float.check: a checksum per frame equals the host decode

audio.mp3_stack_budget.means: stack reserved for a decoder whose one call keeps a large frame on the stack
audio.mp3_stack_budget.check: the image runs with the reserve and the frame size matches the disassembly

time.dwt_cycles_around_call.means: cycles of one call read from the core's cycle counter before and after it

float.soft_float_cost.means: the price of float code on a core with no float unit
float.soft_float_cost.check: cycles per frame on the core with and without the unit

float.fpu_check.means: a count of float-unit instructions and float-library calls in the disassembly
float.fpu_check.check: the count shows the unit in use

fixed_point.none.means: a library that has only a float path and so no fixed-point alternative for a core without a float unit
fixed_point.none.check: the library's source has no integer path

arduino.sketch_board_list.means: a one-file Arduino sketch that lists the boards it supports and stops with an error for any other
arduino.sketch_board_list.check: the build copy compiles and boots with the unmodified original untouched

arduino.auto_prototypes.means: function prototypes written the way the Arduino IDE writes them for a sketch built outside it
arduino.auto_prototypes.check: the sketch compiles with no undeclared function

arduino.serial_console.means: the Arduino Serial calls over a UART with polled transmit and an interrupt receive ring
arduino.serial_console.check: typed characters reach the prompt once each

arduino.time_millis_micros.means: millis, micros and delay from the system tick
arduino.time_millis_micros.check: uLisp's own (time ...) matches a stopwatch and repeats between runs

arduino.digital_pins.means: pinMode, digitalWrite and digitalRead on pin numbers mapped to the board's LEDs
arduino.digital_pins.check: a pin read shows the level written

arduino.analog_tone_spi_i2c_stubs.means: empty Arduino calls that return 0 or an error so a program's own commands compile and fail politely
arduino.analog_tone_spi_i2c_stubs.check: the program builds and the missing feature errors, not crashes

mcu.uart_instance_name.means: a UART block that carries a different instance name on another chip of the family
mcu.uart_instance_name.check: the handler runs: a typed character reaches the program

lisp.autoexec_for_debug_check.means: a build option that feeds a line to an interpreter after reset so a debugger check has something to observe
lisp.autoexec_for_debug_check.check: the observed pin or output changes without typing

perf.cycle_counter_without_dwt.means: a cycle count built from the RTOS tick and the SysTick reload and count on a core whose DWT counter reads 0

tooling.uninitialized_stack_array.means: an engine function that reads a stack array it never fully writes, so a different optimisation level changes the output
tooling.uninitialized_stack_array.check: frame checksums equal across optimisation levels after the array is zeroed

audio.lc3_codec_float.means: encode and decode 10 ms audio frames with the LC3 codec in single-precision float, state in static buffers, no heap
audio.lc3_codec_float.check: encoded bytes and decoded samples equal a host build frame by frame (CRC-32 per frame)

codec.arm_dsp_path_guard.means: turn on a library's Arm DSP code paths that sit behind a compiler-version test the build's compiler does not meet
codec.arm_dsp_path_guard.check: the faster path is really compiled in (cycles fall) and the output bytes stay equal

float.fastmath_changes_bytes.means: a fast-math build writes different bytes from a strict build of the same code
float.fastmath_changes_bytes.check: compare bytes across machines only between strict builds (no fast-math, no fused multiply-add contraction)

float.soft_float_link.means: link a soft-float program on a part whose vendor archive is built hard float
float.soft_float_link.check: the link succeeds and the float code runs without float-unit instructions

size.codec_feature_switch_off.means: drop the optional modes of a codec at build time to cut flash and stack
size.codec_feature_switch_off.check: output equal to the full build for the modes kept; flash and peak stack read from the map

test.integer_signal_generator.means: a test signal made only with integer arithmetic so a host and a board feed a codec identical samples
test.integer_signal_generator.check: the host and board streams are byte-identical

debug.dslite_memory_scale.means: read a block of target memory through the debugger's command line, whose size argument is in words not bytes
debug.dslite_memory_scale.check: the file holds the bytes asked for and the first bytes equal a known value

sensor.fixed_rate_slow_sensors.means: slow I2C sensors read inside a fixed 100 Hz sample loop without breaking the rate
sensor.fixed_rate_slow_sensors.check: the capture shows the requested rate and no missing rows over a minute

time.grid_without_64bit_divide.means: a fixed-rate sample grid kept in 32-bit multiples of the period, since a Cortex-M0+ has no 64-bit divide
time.grid_without_64bit_divide.check: no overrun or drift over a long capture; overruns are printed

display.indexed_to_rgb565_bands.means: an 8-bit palette frame converted to 16-bit colour in bands of rows while the previous band is on the wire by DMA
display.indexed_to_rgb565_bands.check: a known test frame shows the right colours; the frame checksum is taken before conversion

spi.cs_gpio_between_commands.means: chip select driven as a GPIO so it can stay high for a few microseconds between panel commands
spi.cs_gpio_between_commands.check: the panel accepts every command through a level translator

audio.synth_voice_block_render.means: render a synthesizer voice in small fixed-size blocks into a RAM buffer, one call per block, no heap and no output device
audio.synth_voice_block_render.check: every engine's block checksums equal a host build; the engine index really changes the output (24 engines must not give one checksum)

cpp.tiarmclang_cxx_embedded.means: build a C++11 code base with virtual functions and static objects with the vendor Clang, exceptions and RTTI off
cpp.tiarmclang_cxx_embedded.check: the image links with libc++ and runs; output equal to the host build

build.test_macro_collision.means: a library's -D flag has the same name as a field in the vendor SDK header, so the flag is passed to the library files only
build.test_macro_collision.check: the build compiles and the flag is absent from the files that include the SDK

float.strict_equals_host.means: compare float output across machines only between strict builds: same flags, no fast-math, no fused multiply-add contraction
float.strict_equals_host.check: per-block or per-frame checksums equal between the host and the board

test.per_block_crc_reference.means: a CRC-32 per block on the host and on the board, read back as arrays, so a mismatch names the first block and the engine
test.per_block_crc_reference.check: the first differing block index is printed, not only pass or fail

audio.opus_codec_fixed.means: encode and decode Opus with the fixed-point build, state in static buffers sized from the library's size calls, no heap
audio.opus_codec_fixed.check: packets and decoded PCM CRC-32 equal a host build made with the same multiply macros

int.opus_fast_int64.means: a library picks its 32 or 64-bit multiply macros from the host word size, so a 64-bit Mac and a 32-bit core run different arithmetic
int.opus_fast_int64.check: the host reference is built with the macro set to match the target before a mismatch is called a bug

audio.opus_arm_edsp.means: turn on a codec's inline Arm DSP multiply code with a build flag
audio.opus_arm_edsp.check: cycles fall and the output is compared with both host references

float.double_in_codec.means: a float build of a codec that calls double-precision routines on a single-precision FPU
float.double_in_codec.check: the image listing counts the soft-double call sites before a float build is chosen

audio.opus_mode_select.means: steer an Opus encoder to SILK or CELT with application, signal and bandwidth settings, not one mode switch
audio.opus_mode_select.check: the first byte of each packet shows the intended mode

size.opus_os.means: build a codec with the size flag when it costs no cycles
size.opus_os.check: flash from the size tool and cycles equal to the speed build

test.per_frame_crc.means: an array of per-frame packet and decoded-frame CRC-32 values read back with the results
test.per_frame_crc.check: a mismatch names the frame and the side (encoder or decoder)

time.systick_overflow_32bit.means: time calls longer than a 24-bit counter wraps by counting SysTick overflows in the interrupt on a core with no DWT
time.systick_overflow_32bit.check: the clock agrees with a known delay and a host clock

debug.read_ram_without_reset.means: read a running target's RAM through the debugger without a reset
debug.read_ram_without_reset.check: the image keeps running and the results appear once
